steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: Charts and diagrams are visual representations of data that make it easier to understand patterns, trends, and comparisons.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Calculate the angle for a pie chart sector representing 15 students out of a total of 60. | A pictogram uses ⭐ = 6 points. How many stars are needed to represent 27 points? | In a bar chart, what should be the height of the "Blue" bar if 24 people chose blue out of 120 surveyed?
